business_summary: Guangdong KinLong Hardware Products Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of construction and building products in China, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and internationally. The company offers door and window accessories, engineering hardware, premium hardware, kitchen and bathroom, smart home, smart community, chemical building materials, decorative materials, lighting fixtures, electrical materials, transparent led, mechanical and electrical equipment, and sanitation equipment; and integrated solutions, such as residential apartments, hotels/resorts, commercial complex, educational buildings, rail transit, medical buildings, cultural and sports architecture, and factory/industrial park. It provides product integration; service integration; warehousing, logistics, and construction integration; and installation and delivery services, as well as interior design and construction services for commercial venues, office spaces, and public buildings, including planning, design, construction, and after-sales operation. The company also exports its products. Guangdong KinLong Hardware Products Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
